counterexample: The first part holds (1590/1734 classes at L = 32), the second fails - the bounded-width affine quasigroups x + y, 2x + y, 2x + 2y, 2x + 2y + 1 (mod 3, up to relabelling) do not repeat within 5000 steps at L = 32 and 64 (EXP-C15-04).
statement: For at least half of the order-3 classes a random cyclic row of length 32 repeats within 5000 steps, and only classes with geometric streaming width have rows that do not.
title: H-C15-5: cycle detection fast-forwards most automata, and long cycles mean geometric width (refuted in part)
